These two TypeScript modules come from Dalph's Reducer Lab renderer.
The pack copy increases node text size from 10 to 13 and reduces rank separation
from 92 to 60 for this viewport. Other rendering and selection behavior is reused.

Source: `prototypes/reducer-lab/src/delivery-graph-renderer.ts` and
`delivery-graph-element.ts` in [dearlordylord/dalph](https://github.com/dearlordylord/dalph), copied 2026-10-10. Future synchronization is explicit.
